name: Amberhook Reapers
art_brief: Low orchard laborer with twin amber sickles, sprouting shoulder baskets and broad hooked harvest blades; new pale graft shoots frame a compact forward silhouette.

name: Bloomchime Whistlers
art_brief: Bellflower throat mask, curled pollen blowpipe and hanging seed chimes; a high blooming collar and yellow pollen sacs distinguish the light mobile shooter.

name: Vinebraid Lashkeepers
art_brief: Three braided living whips coiled around interwoven root bracers; long lash silhouette and a layered vine mantle show the greater reach without becoming a heavy shield soldier.

name: Sunspine Kites
art_brief: Wide translucent leaf-kite mantle with radial ivory thorn launchers and sunlit seed veins; a spreading triangular canopy distinguishes this nimble ranged organism.

name: Dewglass Restorers
art_brief: Blue-green dew reservoirs under a glass mushroom canopy, articulated salve nozzle and unfurling medicinal fronds; visible clear water and fresh shoots communicate restorative support.

name: Heartseed Wardens
art_brief: Enlarged heart-shaped amber seed shield, seedling spear and overlapping green graft plates; standing guardian with a bright shield core and sheltering foliage.

name: Corkheart Ramparts
art_brief: Massive ram-like bark body with thick cork layers, fresh white shoots and deeply grounded root feet; short angular horn bark catches missiles and throws back splinters.

name: Dawnburst Arbalists
art_brief: Split branch arbalest with three luminous germinating bolt pods and an extended root-stock brace; trained upright orchard artillery with a clear long firing axis.

name: Antlerloom Striders
art_brief: Long-legged grafted stag with luminous woven root antlers and flowering tendon ribbons; wider interlaced antlers and lean running limbs preserve the fast flanking silhouette.

name: Blossomchoir Cantors
art_brief: Hooded living organism with hanging glass seed bells and flowering organ pipes; a broad sheltering blossom mantle spreads above the ranged choir body.

name: Orchardheart Matriarchs
art_brief: Large many-armed graft mother with fruiting halo boughs, suspended restorative sap sacs and bow-like seed-launching arms; heavy amber heart and translucent green fruit show renewal.

name: Evergraft Colossus
art_brief: Towering walking orchard with a deep hollow amber heart, crown of successive fresh grafted canopies and huge root fists; interlocking root feet and layered boughs form a living fortress.
